verdict.rationale: Auth0 describes Actions, its automation units for login and identity flows, as "versioned" Node.js functions. The Auth0 CLI and MCP server can manage tenant configuration and deploy Actions as part of development and deployment workflows. That evidences versioning and controlled deployment, but the pack never documents reviewing changes or rolling back to a prior version. Missing for 10: documented rollback to prior Action versions, review/diff or approval of changes before deploy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
